english: Let $H$ be the hyperbola $\dfrac{x^{2}}{13}-\dfrac{y^{2}}{3}=1$ with foci $S(4,0)$ and $S'(-4,0)$. A ray of light emanating from $S$ strikes the branch of $H$ lying in the region $x>0$ at a point $P$ and, after reflection at $P$, passes through the point $R(30,12)$. If the tangent to $H$ at $P$ meets the $y$-axis at the point $(0,\beta)$, then the value of $\beta$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $H$ अतिपरवलय $\dfrac{x^{2}}{13}-\dfrac{y^{2}}{3}=1$ है जिसकी नाभियाँ $S(4,0)$ तथा $S'(-4,0)$ हैं। $S$ से निकलने वाली एक प्रकाश किरण $H$ की क्षेत्र $x>0$ में स्थित शाखा पर बिन्दु $P$ पर पड़ती है तथा $P$ पर परावर्तन के पश्चात बिन्दु $R(30,12)$ से होकर जाती है। यदि $P$ पर $H$ की स्पर्श रेखा $y$-अक्ष को बिन्दु $(0,\beta)$ पर मिलती है, तो $\beta$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Reflection property: a ray from $S$ reflected at $P$ travels along $S'P$ produced, so $P$ lies on line $S'R$
solution_full: Here $a^{2}=13,\ b^{2}=3,\ c^{2}=16$, so the foci are $(\pm4,0)$ as stated.

Reflection property of the hyperbola: the tangent at $P$ bisects the angle $SPS'$ internally. Hence a ray coming from $S$ and reflected at $P$ moves along the line $S'P$, away from $S'$ (it appears to come from $S'$). So $S'$, $P$, $R$ are collinear with $P$ between $S'$ and $R$.

$x=13$ is a root ($22477-16224-6253=0$); the other root is $-\dfrac{6253}{133\cdot13}=-\dfrac{481}{133}$, which is negative and lies on the other branch. So $P=(13,6)$, which is on $H$: $13-12=1$, and lies between $S'$ and $R$.

Check of the reflection: the tangent $x-2y=1$ has direction $(2,1)$; $\overrightarrow{PS}=(-9,-6)$ and $\overrightarrow{PS'}=(-17,-6)$ make equal angles with the tangent line on opposite sides, as the property requires.
The tangent meets the $y$-axis where $x=0$: $-2y=1$, so $\beta=-\dfrac12=-0.5$.

concept_use.Reflection property of Hyperbola: The reflected ray lies along S'P produced, so P is found as the intersection of line S'R with the right branch: P(13,6).
concept_use.Tangent and normal for Hyperbola: The tangent at P(13,6) is xx1/13 - yy1/3 = 1, i.e. x - 2y = 1, which meets the y-axis at (0,-1/2).

originality_note: New: the point of incidence is not given; it is recovered from a far point on the reflected ray, by intersecting the line through the other focus with the branch (way 5). Closest known: textbook statements of the reflection property; tangent at a given point of a hyperbola. Different because: the reflection property is used in reverse to locate P before the tangent is written.
stem_review: Read as a student: every curve, point and parameter introduced, conditions complete (quadrant / sign / branch stated), one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer equals the plan (negative decimal: -0.5). Changed: No change. Checked that the second intersection of line S'R with H is on the branch x<0, so P is unique on the stated branch, and that R lies beyond P on the reflected ray.
key_step: Use the reflection property to put P on line S'R, then solve with H and write the tangent.
justification: Routine chain: reflection property, line-curve intersection with one root rejected, tangent at a point. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q4 (L2), a routine hyperbola tangent question.
